about:
Helix Mechanical has been servicing San Diego for over 20 years from El Cajon.

We hold C-20 for heating and air, C-36 for plumbing, and a Class B general building licence — which means one contractor can handle the mechanical work and the building work behind it, instead of you coordinating three trades.
